item.title: LLM Inference Platform Engineering - Part 1 - Overview of the Beast
item.description:
Intro

Inference Platform Engineering is an area that is becoming increasingly popular due to the widespread use of LLMs everywhere. If we think about it, it makes perfect sense: you are not writing code by hand anymore, are you? :) However, the LLM you prompt to rewrite your perfectly working application to Rust needs to run somewhere. Today, 99% of the time, you don’t care where. You just fire up Claude or the latest version of ChatGPT, which reads your prompt, waits a bit, and spits out the answer – so you might ask: why would I even need to understand how tun run an LLM then?

item.title: About
item.description:
I’m currently a tech lead at Veeam for the central platform engineering team.

What I work on

I spend most of my time in the intersection of:

  • Platform & Infrastructure Engineering — Kubernetes, cloud-native tooling, GitOps, IaC, Pulumi, etc.
  • Developer Experience — internal platforms, CI/CD, making the boring stuff fast
  • Scalability — I really like to design systems for scale – I especially like to work on all the problems that scalability presents.
  • Operations — I’m the one annoying engineer who keeps reminding managers to let our teams spend more time on operations (dashboards, alarms, metrics… you name it).'
